title: Letters made of rain
alt: The word RAIN appears as clear glass letters covered in droplets beside a wet window.
description: Material-aware typography uses transparent glass, condensation and coherent reflections.
prompt: A close still life on a rain-soaked slate sill. Four large free-standing blocks of cast transparent glass spell “RAIN” in capitals. The letters stand in four distinct positions along a line, leaving clear dark slivers of background between them. Minute water droplets, a single fallen leaf and splintered reflections in shallow puddles. Cool natural light from a rainy window. Only the four letters, complete in frame, no punctuation or caption.
